title: Chapter 18
text: Special Thanks Original Story and Script Supervision by Kafka Asagiri Manga Illustration by Sango Harukawa Director: Takuya Igarashi Script: Yoji Enokido Character Design and Chief Animation Director: Nobuhiro Arai This novel is the complete version of the bonus story “Dazai, Chuuya, Age Fifteen” given to audiences during the second week of the animated movie Bungo Stray Dogs: Dead Apple’ s theatrical release in 2018.
